sketch.name: QualityLotBoard
sketch.description: A purified-ethanol quality board: lot release summary, status filter chips and a list of lots with each lab test coloured against its spec, status chip, CoA flag and a per-test detail row for the selected lot.

props.name: lots
props.description: Lots: { lot, plant, grade, vessel, sampled, status (Released/Hold/Fail/Pending), coaIssued, results } where results is compact text: test=value;test=value.

props.name: specs
props.description: Test limits: { test, unit, min, max }. A value is out of spec beyond a limit and amber within 10% of it. The test name matches the key in a lot's results.

props.name: statusFilter
props.description: Shows only lots of this status: all, released, hold, fail or pending.

props.name: selected
props.description: Lot number of the selected lot, whose per-test detail is shown.

sketch.notes: Simple control (rows, no items collections). Parts: the board, the lot-selected and filter-changed event args, enums none (status as text), client class, theme mixin, icon. Results kept as compact "test=value;test=value" text (rows cannot nest), parsed client-side; the server passes it through. Amber margin: 10% of the band (min..max) or of the single limit. Test name keys are matched case-insensitively. Narrow (<560px) shows colour dots instead of test cells.
